title: 倒著播放歌單
question: 請輸入 5 首歌的編號存進清單，然後從最後一首倒著播回第一首：用迴圈把編號倒過來輸出，一行一個。

test_case.note: 一樣的編號也照順序倒過來

en.title: Play the Songs Backward
en.question: Input the numbers of 5 songs into a list. Then play them from the last one back to the first: use a loop to output the numbers backward, one on each line.

test_case.note: Same numbers: still reverse the order
